payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage dreaming, primary /magazine and a Wedded Advisor secondary after the legal section, matching the services.md early-stage rule. The primary sits at the close, where a reader who came for the customs has finished and the natural next step is more reading, not an enquiry. The secondary sits where the panel's question peaks: the legal and travel-advice section raises 'who handles the marriage office dates, documents and travel', and the line answers it with brand-facts.md claims only (single point of contact, venue, travel and vendors, inclusions and fee in writing). Panel cta_reactions: planner_couple 'maybe', wants to see what the Advisor does before the link (venue, travel, vendors and the in-writing line already precede it) and a real Turkish wedding (we hold none; open question); sceptic 'maybe' pending what the fee buys (fee-in-writing line precedes the link; fee model is not in brand-facts.md, so not added); funding_parent 'maybe' if it means a phone call with a named person and uhnw 'maybe' wanting scale and privacy (neither in brand-facts.md, not added); search_visitor 'no', prefers the pillar link, which stays. Weighted enquiry likelihood 2.5 is expected for a dreaming-stage culture guide. Lead magnet suggestion: a Türkiye or Europe issue of the magazine (link map lists only Australia, Fiji and Dubai issues) would be the ideal magnet for this post; it does not exist, so it is not placed. No prices, no new business details, no em dashes.
